manifest_row.title: Congo basin's peaty swamps are new front in climate change battle

screening.main_topic: The discovery and protection of extensive peatlands in the Congo Basin as globally significant carbon stores.
screening.climate_relevance: The article explains how peatlands store carbon, how draining or deforestation can release large quantities of CO2 and intensify climate change, and how research and policy could protect these carbon sinks.
